title: A bill to rename the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Butte, Montana, as the "Charlie Dowd VA Clinic".
official_summary: This act designates the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Butte, Montana, as the Charlie Dowd Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic or the Charlie Dowd VA Clinic.

summary.headline: Renames the VA community-based outpatient clinic in Butte, Montana, as the Charlie Dowd VA Clinic.
summary.what_it_does: This law changes the official name of the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Butte, Montana. The clinic will now be called the Charlie Dowd Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic, or the Charlie Dowd VA Clinic. The law does not change the clinic's services, staff, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect on enactment, July 30, 2024.
